selection_rule: candidate decisions use repeated-census structure, stable unit identity, geometry, survey design, data accessibility and prior Structural provenance; no candidate is promoted because a source-leverage effect direction is known

candidates.system: Azores long-term forest arthropod SLAM monitoring

metadata.occurrence_extension_records_reported: 14922 in Data Records section versus 14924 in methods text; raw archive must resolve
metadata.sampling_frequency: approximately four standardized SLAM-trap collections per year
metadata.critical_taxonomic_gap: Pico and Terceira Araneae are intentionally excluded from the main archive and published separately

candidates.decision_reason: The event-core/occurrence-extension separation allows survey timing, plot continuity and island-year completeness to be audited before focal species response values are parsed. This is the cleanest currently located route toward an independent temporal source-loss test, but it is not confirmatory-eligible until the raw archive passes an event-only coverage audit, taxonomic completeness is frozen and two disjoint three-time windows are shown to exist.

candidates.system: Finnish Archipelago Bird Census / Common Eider (Somateria mollissima)

metadata.standard_monitoring: breeding numbers estimated by at least two annual counts under Archipelago Bird Census guidelines for the core monitoring programme
metadata.spatial_support: islands assigned to 2x2 km grid cells for published spatial covariance; public dataset description includes pos2 plus rounded standardized latitude/longitude
metadata.sampling_balance: unbalanced; average about 500 islands surveyed annually, with 100-1200 depending on year
metadata.known_data_complication: some additional-source counts were reported for groups of islands and redistributed to individual islands; publication reports about 6.2% of observations per year affected

candidates.decision_reason: This remains the strongest immediately available retrospective stress-test geometry: many repeated island counts, stable island IDs and annual coverage over 24 years. It cannot count as pristine confirmation because the publication already reports broad eider decline and redistribution. Before any Structural source-leverage score is computed, a schema-only audit must establish whether public spatial support is deterministic, whether zeros are surveyed zeros, and whether redistributed multi-island counts can be identified or prospectively retained.

metadata.monitoring_start: bird surveys began 2003; 42 islands since 2007; 36 reported to have consistent data through the long-term programme

candidates.decision_reason: The field programme is an excellent design match, but the located public deposits do not expose the required annual island-by-species raw sequence with a frozen survey-effort rule. Aggregate community outputs cannot identify t0 sources, t0-to-t1 losses and t1-to-t2 contraction without reconstruction from unavailable response values.

candidates.system: Thousand Island Lake long-term vegetation plots

metadata.programme_statement: 29 island vegetation plots surveyed every five years since 2009

candidates.decision_reason: Plant occurrence is attractive because detection is less problematic than bird occurrence, but the public material located so far does not establish an accessible three-census island-by-species matrix under one frozen census protocol. The 2009-2010 establishment period and later woody censuses cannot be assumed equivalent without an authoritative crosswalk.

The temporal and geographic coverage are exceptional, but the archived derivative is observation-positive oriented. Its documented file schema does not include the complete-checklist, duration, protocol and effort fields needed to distinguish a true surveyed zero from non-reporting for a focal species. Species-specific t0/t1/t2 absence would therefore be unsafe from this archive alone.

A-Islands is already a Structural discovery system for source-network hypotheses, so it cannot serve as an independent confirmation of the source-loss leverage mechanism. Its heterogeneous asynchronous resurvey structure also makes the three-time transition less clean. It may be used only for retrospective engineering that is explicitly excluded from the confirmation denominator.

preferred_response_unopened_preintake.reason: Sampling events can be audited separately from focal taxon occurrence, giving the cleanest current response firewall.
